analysis_steps.goal: Calibrate and image cubes and continuum

analysis_steps.goal: Extract spectra and fit line components

method.value: Spectra from 6x6 arcsec (CO1-0) and 3x3 arcsec (CO3-2) regions fitted with two Gaussians

evidence.quote: These spectral profiles were each fitted with two Gaussian components using the package MPFIT

validation.value: larger 6x6 arcsec region at CO(3-2) gave consistent total flux

evidence.quote: A larger $6\times6\rm\; arcsec$ region at CO(3-2) produces a consistent total flux but a significantly noisier spectrum.

analysis_steps.goal: Make moment maps and PV diagrams

method.value: Integrated intensity maps over velocity ranges; PV cuts along PA 77 deg (systemic) and 120 deg (HVS), PA from 2D Gaussian fit

evidence.quote: A two-dimensional Gaussian was fitted to the integrated intensity maps of the BCG systemic component to determine this best fit PA

validation.value: PA consistent between CO(1-0) and CO(3-2)

evidence.quote: this was found to be consistent at both CO(1-0) and CO(3-2) within the error

findings_qualitative.value: Systemic component shows smooth velocity gradient consistent with solid-body rotation but highly asymmetric

evidence.quote: the mass and velocity structure are highly asymmetric and could indicate an inflow of gas in the process of forming a relaxed disk

claims.hypothesis: The BCG hosts massive molecular gas flows
claims.experiment: ALMA CO(1-0) and CO(3-2) spectra and maps
claims.result: Two components, systemic and HVS at -570 km/s, each ~5e9 Msun

evidence.quote: reveal two massive molecular gas flows each with a mass of $M_{\rm mol}\sim5\times10^{9}

claims.experiment: Energetics compared with radiation, supernovae and AGN power
claims.result: Outflow needs ~35% of AGN mechanical energy; radiation and SNe insufficient
claims.finding: Outflow most likely AGN-driven, though inflow cannot be excluded

evidence.quote: Based on the energy requirements, we suggest that this outflow would most likely be driven by the central AGN.
A merger origin for the high velocity system is possible but we consider it unlikely.

limitations_admitted.value: Cannot tell whether gas lies in front of or behind the BCG

evidence.quote: we cannot distinguish between an inflow of gas located behind the BCG and an outflow of gas located in front of the BCG.

referee_caveats_inferred: X_CO assumed Galactic; masses scale with it
Interferometer may resolve out flux (half of IRAM flux)
Inflow vs outflow ambiguous without absorption
Outflow age and AGN power uncertain by an order of magnitude
